title: Harden scripts/run-eval.sh's assembled plugin tree: stage committed bytes, verify result path and cleanup trap
description: Follow-up from the Opus review of #204 (WCLI-92), not started. (a) LOW: run-eval.sh copies plugin/ from the working tree (cp -R plugin/.), not the committed bytes, so an uncommitted SKILL.md edit or an untracked plugin/notes.md gets scored, and the header comment on what is evaluated overclaims. Fix: stage with git archive HEAD plugin, or refuse while git status --porcelain -- plugin/ is non-empty. (b) Unverified: where claude plugin eval resolves --json evals/results/<x>.json, against the cwd or the scratch tree (it fails closed either way, since the script exits when no result file exists); and whether the EXIT trap removing the scratch tree fires on SIGINT and SIGTERM. Not part of this task: the reviewer recommends one real selective ./scripts/run-eval.sh ward run before the 0.1.1 cut; that is an acceptance criterion of the cut, not of this follow-up.

acceptanceCriteria.text: run-eval.sh evaluates the committed bytes of plugin/, or refuses when plugin/ has uncommitted or untracked changes, and its header says which
The --json result path resolution and the scratch tree cleanup on SIGINT and SIGTERM are each measured, and the script comment states what was measured
